faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.q1: Where does the part and fitment data come from?
faq.a1: PartLister uses trusted TecDoc product and vehicle data to generate listings with OE references, interchangeable numbers, compatibility, engine codes and technical specifications. We don't invent product data with AI.
faq.q2: What can I enter to generate a listing?
faq.a2: You can generate a listing using an OE Number, OEM Number, or TecDoc Article Number. Simply paste your reference number and PartLister builds the listing automatically.
faq.a3: Every listing can include an SEO-optimised title, product description, item specifics, vehicle compatibility, engine codes, OE references, interchangeable numbers, market pricing, and CSV export.
faq.a4: Compatibility is generated directly from TecDoc vehicle application data. We always recommend verifying compatibility before publishing, but PartLister removes the need to manually research hundreds of applications yourself.
faq.q5: How does the free trial work?
faq.a5: Every new account includes 10 free listings. No credit card required. You can explore every core feature before choosing a subscription.
faq.a6: Yes. You can instantly copy HTML, export to CSV, save listings for later, and use your preferred marketplace workflow.
faq.q7: Does PartLister calculate eBay fees and profit?
faq.a7: Yes. Our Smart Pricing tool calculates eBay fees, VAT, shipping, packaging, advertising costs, profit, margin and markup — helping you price every listing confidently.
faq.a8: AI helps optimise titles and descriptions. Your product specifications, compatibility and OE references come from trusted automotive data sources rather than being generated by AI. This gives you the speed of AI with the reliability of verified catalogue data.
faq.a9: PartLister is built for eBay sellers, motor factors, automotive retailers, engine rebuilders, parts distributors, salvage yards, commercial vehicle specialists — anyone creating automotive parts listings at scale.
faq.q10: Why use PartLister instead of copying from TecDoc?
faq.a10: Instead of manually copying information between TecDoc, eBay and spreadsheets, PartLister generates a complete listing in seconds — less manual work, fewer mistakes, better SEO, consistent listings, and more time selling.
